articles.title: Vorwürfe gegen Christian Ulmen: Tausende demonstrieren in Berlin gegen sexualisierte Gewalt
articles.teaser: Am Brandenburger Tor haben sich mehrere tausend Menschen mit Collien Fernandes solidarisiert. Sie wirft dem Produzenten Christian Ulmen digitale Gewalt vor.
articles.image_title: Vorwürfe gegen Christian Ulmen: BERLIN, GERMANY - MARCH 22: Protesters hold a placard reading "Whether offline or online, there must be consent " as they take part in a demonstration demonstration in support of Actress Collien Fernandes who called for against sexual, psychological and physical violence directed at women on March 22, 2026 at the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, Germany. Fernandes has filed charges against her husband, actor Christian Ulmen, over several accusations, including her claim that he shared deepfake sexual images of her online. Fernandes is calling for better legislation in Germany to protect women against online sexual attacks. (Photo by Maryam Majd/Getty Images)

articles.title: Havanna: Kuba meldet erneut einen landesweiten Stromausfall
articles.teaser: Zum zweiten Mal innerhalb einer Woche ist Kubas Stromnetz zusammengebrochen. Ein Ölembargo der USA hat die Energieversorgung des Landes stark verschlechtert.

articles.title: Klimawandel: Zahlreiche US-Städte messen Rekordtemperaturen
articles.teaser: Im Westen der USA werden Temperaturen bis zu 44 Grad gemessen. Folgen des Klimawandels, sagen Forschungsgruppen. Auf Hawaii droht nach Starkregen ein Dammbruch.
articles.image_title: Klimawandel: A person wears a hat for shade under the morning sun while walking along The Strand in Redondo Beach, California on March 20, 2026, during a heat wave. A record early heat wave striking the west of the United States on March 20 is a one-in-500-years type event and all but certainly the result of human-caused climate change, experts say. The heat has been toppling records this week and was set to continue into the weekend across western cities, expanding eastward. (Photo by Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Images)
